# Copilot instructions

The instructions for this repo are in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) — tool-neutral and written for any
AI assistant. Read it first, then [INDEX.md](../INDEX.md), the map of every file.

Short version: never invent numbers (read them from a run's `summary.json`); never edit `raw/`;
update `INDEX.md` when you add a file; run `make check` before claiming you are done.
